items.heading: Svickova
details: Key ingredients: beef, root vegetables, cream, bread dumplings
Marinate beef with root vegetables for a day for depth of flavor.
Braise the beef and vegetables slowly until tender.
Puree the vegetables with cream into a smooth, tangy sauce.
Slice the beef and serve smothered in sauce with bread dumplings.

items.heading: Trdelnik
details: Key ingredients: flour dough, sugar, cinnamon, walnuts
Roll strips of yeasted dough and wrap them around a wooden spit.
Roll the coated spit in sugar and chopped walnuts.
Grill slowly over embers, turning until golden and caramelized.
Slide off the spit and dust with extra cinnamon sugar.
